limitations.note: The patch focused on triangular-wave direction and left both square-wave terminal comparisons at 20 instead of 19, retaining a 21-clock period rather than the intended 20.

The triangle rewrite fixes the upper turnaround but also changes reset and mode-entry behavior: the first triangle tick from zero now produces 1 instead of the 5-bit wrap to 31 that the reference preserves.
The passing test explicitly expected the defective 21-clock square-wave period and likewise assumed the rewritten triangle startup, so it could not catch either mismatch.
The agent opened a guide with a relevant off-by-one section, but that advice did not translate into checking the square-wave terminal count against the lengths of its high and low phases.
